package.description: Fast and free online prototyping tool for web and app projects.

en-US.description: Fast and free online prototyping tool for web and app projects.
en-US.longDescription: Mockplus RP is a web-based prototyping tool that allows users to create everything from sketches and wireframes to high-fidelity prototypes. It supports a wide range of visual designs, including web and mobile app artboards, and offers vector tools for detailed customization. Users can drag-and-drop premade shapes and widgets to create interactive prototypes, which can be tested and shared easily. The tool also supports real-time team collaboration and allows importing Axure files for seamless editing and feedback collection.
en-US.name: Mockplus RP

zh-CN.description: 用于网络和应用项目的快速免费在线原型工具
zh-CN.longDescription: Mockplus RP 是一款在线原型设计工具，允许用户创建从草图、线框图到高保真原型的所有内容。它支持多种可视化设计，包括网页和移动应用艺术板，并提供矢量工具进行详细定制。用户可以拖放预制图形和小部件来创建交互式原型，并可轻松进行测试和共享。该工具还支持实时团队协作，并允许导入 Axure 文件进行无缝编辑和反馈收集。
zh-CN.name: Mockplus RP
